## The pages {#sec-split-pages}

The definitions that were on this page are now on three pages:

- [Sets](sets.qmd):
  sets, subsets, unions, intersections, complements, Cartesian products,
  and the extended non-negative real numbers.
- [Functions](functions.qmd):
  functions with their domains, codomains, and images,
  composition, inverses, sequences, and countable sets.
- [Expressions and Algorithms](expressions-algorithms.qmd):
  expressions, parse trees, and algorithms.
